advisories.summary: compromised build pipeline shipped a cryptominer downloader; 8.3.43 is the clean release
credential-stealing payload runs on import (GitHub/npm/AWS/Azure/GCP tokens); 2.6.1 is the last known-clean release
dependency-confusion package: the name on PyPI is not PyTorch's; the legitimate dependency is pytorch-triton on PyTorch's own index
CVE-2026-4372: a config.json field can name a Hub kernel repository that is downloaded and imported on load, outside the reach of trust_remote_code=False (requires the 'kernels' extra)
CVE-2024-34359: a GGUF model's chat template is rendered with an unsandboxed Jinja2 environment, so a template gadget executes code on load
CVE-2026-5760: the rerank endpoint renders a model-supplied chat template with jinja2.Environment() instead of the sandboxed one, giving RCE on the inference server
CVE-2025-32434: torch.load reaches code execution even with weights_only=True, so the documented safe path is not one
CVE-2025-9905: load_model silently ignores safe_mode for legacy .h5/.hdf5 files, so a Lambda layer in one executes regardless
